explanation: West Side Story won 10 of its 11 nominations. The Godfather won three, for best picture, actor and adapted screenplay, and Marlon Brando declined his.

claims.text: West Side Story (1961) won 10 competitive Academy Awards, from 11 nominations.
The Godfather (1972) won 3 Academy Awards: Best Picture, Best Actor and Best Adapted Screenplay.
Marlon Brando declined the Oscar he won for playing Vito Corleone in The Godfather.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Claims: every claim listed, risk at or above the C26 floor and raised where a detail is easy to get wrong; the schema's riskReason list has no 'only' or 'counterintuitive', so such claims carry the nearest listed reason. Datasets: no pinned dataset covers film or TV facts, so every high-risk claim here needs checker evidence from the web. Rival test: The Godfather's reputation as one of the greatest films pulls players toward it; whether Brando's declined award is counted (3 or 2), West Side Story wins easily. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: two world-famous films; no local knowledge is needed. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 25 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json; no claim resembles a listed myth. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: the 1961 film is named with its year to rule out the 2021 remake.
